{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct: remove commas from revenue and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders only, and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
